simple.summary: לְבָנָה (lᵉbânâh) means properly, (the) white , i.e. the moon First listed occurrence: Isa 24 23.

definitions.full: H3842. lebanah I. לְבָּנָה noun feminine moon , in poetry (Late Hebrew id. ); — ׳ל Isa 24:23 2 t.; shall pale before ׳י 24:23 (|| חַמָּה ); shall become like sun ( חַמָּה ) in day of ׳י s redemption 30:26 ( הַלְּ ׳אוֺר ); simile of woman's beauty, כַלְּ ׳יָפָה Song 6:10 (|| חַמָּה ).
